```{r}
#| label: setup

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)

source(here("R", "chip.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "10-implementation", "results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Data and denominator

```{r}
#| label: read-data

alterations <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-alterations.parquet")
)
samples <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-ctdna-samples.parquet")
)

# Patients with at least one valid ctDNA result, in order of first appearance.
valid_patient_ids <- samples |>
  filter(as.logical(valid_ctdna_result) %in% TRUE, !is.na(id)) |>
  pull(id) |>
  unique()

if (length(valid_patient_ids) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "Actionability is pending because no valid ctDNA-result patient is recorded."
  )
}
denominator <- length(valid_patient_ids)
```

```{r}
#| label: alteration-types

alteration_records <- alterations |>
  mutate(
    chip_classification = classify_chip_status(
      alteration_type,
      found_in_solid_biopsy,
      found_in_buffy_coat
    ),
    # Harmonise the type only after classifying CHIP, which needs the source type.
    alteration_type = tolower(trimws(as.character(alteration_type))),
    alteration_type = case_when(
      alteration_type %in% c("snv", "snp", "indel", "small_variant") ~
        "mutation",
      alteration_type %in% c("copy_number", "copy number", "copy-number") ~
        "cnv",
      alteration_type %in% c("structural_variant", "structural variant") ~
        "fusion",
      .default = alteration_type
    )
  )

if (nrow(alteration_records) > 0L &&
    !any(alteration_records$alteration_type %in% c("mutation", "cnv", "fusion"))) {
  stop("Actionability alteration_type has no mutation, CNV, or fusion records.")
}
```

## Records under the two CHIP assumptions

```{r}
#| label: scenario-records

assumptions <- c(
  "Assume ctDNA-only unknowns are not CHIP",
  "Assume ctDNA-only unknowns are CHIP"
)

scenario_records <- cross_join(
  tibble(assumption = assumptions),
  alteration_records
) |>
  mutate(
    non_chip = if_else(
      alteration_type == "mutation",
      chip_classification %in% c(
        "definite_non_chip",
        "tissue_positive_buffy_missing"
      ) |
        (assumption == assumptions[[1]] &
           chip_classification == "ctdna_only_unknown"),
      alteration_type %in% c("cnv", "fusion")
    ),
    sensitivity = trimws(as.character(sensitivity)),
    resistance = trimws(as.character(resistance))
  ) |>
  filter(
    as.logical(valid_ctdna_result) %in% TRUE,
    non_chip,
    alteration_type %in% c("mutation", "cnv", "fusion")
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: evidence-rule

is_recorded_actionability_evidence <- function(level) {
  values <- trimws(as.character(level))
  non_evidence <- c(
    "unknown", "not_assessed", "not assessed", "not available",
    "not_applicable", "not applicable", "not tested", "not_tested",
    "not performed", "not_performed", "not reported", "not_reported",
    "pending", "no evidence", "no_evidence", "no level", "no_level",
    "none", "na", "n/a"
  )
  !(is.na(values) | !nzchar(values) | tolower(values) %in% non_evidence)
}
```

## Long actionability table

```{r}
#| label: long-table

long <- scenario_records |>
  pivot_longer(
    c(sensitivity, resistance),
    names_to = "actionability_type",
    values_to = "actionability_level",
    cols_vary = "slowest"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    recorded_exact_level = !is.na(actionability_level) &
      nzchar(actionability_level)
  ) |>
  select(
    id,
    alteration_id,
    assumption,
    alteration_type,
    actionability_type,
    actionability_level,
    onkb_version,
    onkb_updated_date,
    recorded_exact_level,
    non_chip,
    valid_ctdna_result
  )

long_evidence <- long |>
  filter(is_recorded_actionability_evidence(actionability_level))

write_parquet(
  long,
  file.path(results_dir, "actionability-long.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

## Completeness of recorded levels

```{r}
#| label: completeness

actionability_qc <- long |>
  filter(!is_recorded_actionability_evidence(actionability_level)) |>
  mutate(
    recorded_value = trimws(as.character(actionability_level)),
    recorded_value = case_when(
      is.na(recorded_value) ~ "<missing>",
      !nzchar(recorded_value) ~ "<blank>",
      .default = recorded_value
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    assumption,
    evidence_direction = actionability_type,
    recorded_value
  ) |>
  summarise(
    alteration_records_n = n(),
    patients_n = n_distinct(id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_parquet(
  actionability_qc,
  file.path(results_dir, "actionability-level-completeness.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

## Alteration and patient counts by exact level

```{r}
#| label: current-levels

current_levels <- tibble(
  actionability_type = c(rep("sensitivity", 5L), rep("resistance", 2L)),
  actionability_level = c("1", "2", "3A", "3B", "4", "R1", "R2"),
  onkb_category = c(
    "Standard care",
    "Standard care",
    "Investigational",
    "Investigational",
    "Hypothetical",
    "Standard-care resistance",
    "Investigational resistance"
  ),
  within_direction_position = c(
    "1 (strongest)", "2", "3", "4", "5 (weakest)",
    "1 (strongest)", "2"
  ),
  level_meaning = c(
    "FDA-recognized biomarker predictive of response to an FDA-approved drug in the same indication",
    "Standard-care biomarker recommended by the NCCN or other professional guidelines and predictive of response to an FDA-approved drug in the same indication",
    "Compelling clinical evidence supports the biomarker as predictive of response to a drug in the same indication",
    "Standard-care or investigational biomarker predictive of response to an FDA-approved or investigational drug in another indication",
    "Compelling biological evidence supports the biomarker as predictive of response to a drug",
    "Standard-care biomarker predictive of resistance to an FDA-approved drug in the same indication",
    "Compelling clinical evidence supports the biomarker as predictive of resistance to a drug"
  )
) |>
  mutate(level_position = row_number())
```

```{r}
#| label: level-summary

observed_levels <- long_evidence |>
  distinct(
    assumption,
    id,
    alteration_id,
    actionability_type,
    actionability_level,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) |>
  group_by(assumption, actionability_type, actionability_level) |>
  summarise(
    onkb_versions = sort(unique(trimws(as.character(onkb_version)))) |>
      str_subset(".") |>
      paste(collapse = ", ") |>
      na_if(""),
    onkb_update_range = if (all(is.na(onkb_updated_date))) {
      NA_character_
    } else {
      range(as.Date(onkb_updated_date), na.rm = TRUE) |>
        format("%Y-%m-%d") |>
        paste(collapse = " to ")
    },
    mutation_count = sum(alteration_type == "mutation"),
    mutation_patient_count = n_distinct(id[alteration_type == "mutation"]),
    cnv_count = sum(alteration_type == "cnv"),
    cnv_patient_count = n_distinct(id[alteration_type == "cnv"]),
    fusion_count = sum(alteration_type == "fusion"),
    fusion_patient_count = n_distinct(id[alteration_type == "fusion"]),
    alteration_count = n(),
    patient_count = n_distinct(id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    level_code = sub("^LEVEL[ _-]*", "", toupper(trimws(actionability_level)))
  )

zero_levels <- cross_join(
  tibble(assumption = assumptions),
  select(current_levels, actionability_type, level_code = actionability_level)
) |>
  anti_join(
    observed_levels,
    by = c("assumption", "actionability_type", "level_code")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    actionability_level = paste0("LEVEL_", level_code),
    onkb_versions = NA_character_,
    onkb_update_range = NA_character_,
    mutation_count = 0L,
    mutation_patient_count = 0L,
    cnv_count = 0L,
    cnv_patient_count = 0L,
    fusion_count = 0L,
    fusion_patient_count = 0L,
    alteration_count = 0L,
    patient_count = 0L
  )

actionability_levels <- bind_rows(observed_levels, zero_levels) |>
  left_join(
    rename(current_levels, level_code = actionability_level),
    by = c("actionability_type", "level_code")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    onkb_category = coalesce(
      onkb_category,
      "Version-specific or non-canonical recorded value"
    ),
    level_meaning = coalesce(
      level_meaning,
      "Review the exact recorded value against the recorded OncoKB version"
    ),
    denominator_valid_ctdna_patients = denominator,
    patient_proportion = patient_count / denominator
  ) |>
  arrange(
    match(assumption, assumptions),
    is.na(level_position),
    level_position,
    actionability_type,
    actionability_level
  ) |>
  select(
    assumption,
    actionability_type,
    actionability_level,
    onkb_category,
    within_direction_position,
    level_meaning,
    onkb_versions,
    onkb_update_range,
    mutation_count,
    mutation_patient_count,
    cnv_count,
    cnv_patient_count,
    fusion_count,
    fusion_patient_count,
    alteration_count,
    patient_count,
    denominator_valid_ctdna_patients,
    patient_proportion
  )

write_parquet(
  actionability_levels,
  file.path(results_dir, "actionability-level-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

## Patient-level actionability

```{r}
#| label: patient-summary

patient_evidence <- scenario_records |>
  summarise(
    any_sensitivity = any(is_recorded_actionability_evidence(sensitivity)),
    any_resistance = any(is_recorded_actionability_evidence(resistance)),
    .by = c(assumption, id)
  )

patient_summary <- cross_join(
  tibble(assumption = assumptions),
  tibble(id = valid_patient_ids)
) |>
  left_join(patient_evidence, by = c("assumption", "id")) |>
  mutate(
    any_sensitivity = replace_na(any_sensitivity, FALSE),
    any_resistance = replace_na(any_resistance, FALSE),
    any_actionable = any_sensitivity | any_resistance,
    no_actionable_finding = !any_sensitivity & !any_resistance
  )

actionability_summary <- patient_summary |>
  summarise(
    "Any sensitivity evidence" = sum(any_sensitivity),
    "Any resistance evidence" = sum(any_resistance),
    "Any sensitivity or resistance evidence" = sum(any_actionable),
    "Both sensitivity and resistance evidence" =
      sum(any_sensitivity & any_resistance),
    "No actionable finding" = sum(no_actionable_finding),
    .by = assumption
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    -assumption,
    names_to = "patient_category",
    values_to = "patient_count"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    denominator_valid_ctdna_patients = denominator,
    patient_proportion = patient_count / denominator
  )

write_parquet(
  patient_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "actionability-patient-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  actionability_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "actionability-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: actionability-patient-prevalence
#| tbl-cap: "Patients with at least one non-CHIP alteration at each exact OncoKB therapeutic level"

actionability_levels |>
  select(
    assumption,
    evidence_direction = actionability_type,
    exact_recorded_level = actionability_level,
    patients_with_mutation_n = mutation_patient_count,
    patients_with_cnv_n = cnv_patient_count,
    patients_with_fusion_n = fusion_patient_count,
    patients_with_any_alteration_n = patient_count,
    validly_tested_patients_n = denominator_valid_ctdna_patients,
    any_alteration_patient_proportion = patient_proportion
  ) |>
  kable()
```
